verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail is an online virtual-mailbox service with web access and an API, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking controls. The option to have mail left unopened and unscanned, and the 2FA feature, are related security and privacy features rather than tracking opt-outs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
